maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from cloud storage and collaboration subscriptions (Dropbox plans, Sign, DocSend), not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by individual consumers and business teams subscribing to Dropbox plans; education customers are a small share.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through subscriptions and its own product launches; acquisitions like HelloSign and DocSend were occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Stores customers' files and workflows; migrating large libraries, retraining teams and rebuilding integrations makes switching costly and disruptive.
